title: Implement Rust Session Backend In Semio Server
description: Implement the Rust session-backend service in semio/server/ as a separate crate with small module files (max 200 LOC each). The crate depends on semio domain types from semio/rs. Includes: session domain types (FieldPatch, PropertyKey, ConflictPolicy), session state, PostgreSQL persistence with typed tables, session actor with single-writer semantics, HTTP/WebSocket API with axum, SQL schema migrations, and tests. All per the implementation plan at .repo/drafts/rust-session-backend-implementation-plan.md.
